The '''Ayceezee system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]' [[Kanz sector/Legends|Kanz sector]]. [[Voort saBinring]] went into temporary retirement on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ayceezee]].<ref name="X-Wing: Mercy Kill">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>
